crossRefs.note: Say to the king and to the queen mother, “Humble yourselves. Sit down, for your crowns have come down, even the crown…
Tell them, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word, you kings of Judah, all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by…
I said, “Please listen, you heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: Isn’t it for you to know justice?

translations.web: “Concerning the house of the king of Judah, hear Yahweh’s word:
translations.bsb: Moreover, tell the house of the king of Judah to hear the word of the LORD.
translations.kjv: And touching the house of the king of Judah, say, Hear ye the word of the LORD;
translations.asv: And touching the house of the king of Judah, hear ye the word of Jehovah:
